description:
Get an on-demand California surf outlook for a forecastSupported spot ID from list_california_spots. Offshore swell ft/period s/directions FROM, wind kt/FROM, NOAA tide predictions ft MLLW and dated buoy observations. Offshore waves are not breaking-wave heights. Includes an experimental Gillby capped surf preference score (0–100), per-hour factors and model version. Missing essential inputs yield null. This is not a calibrated break-level surf rating; no beach advisory or shark-risk assessment is supplied. Includes parking guidance with checkedAt and official sources (availability null), localGuide where researched, exact NOAA tideEvents ft MLLW, dated NWS regional surf/rip-risk reports for supported Los Angeles spots, detailStatus with separate issues/retrieval time, and planning.days with morning/afternoon ranges in America/Los_Angeles. Null regional/localGuide means unavailable, not safe conditions. locationCameras matches the requested spot and supplies snapshotPath for refreshing JPEG previews, mediaType and unknown capture times; previews are not live video. cameras retains regional camera source links and provider-hosted YouTube IDs where available; these views may differ from the requested break and stream uptime is not guaranteed. Preserve issues and timestamps. sourceStatus distinguishes retrieval, observedAt, issuedAt (null when unknown), forecast validFrom/validThrough, current/stale/unavailable/unknown states, refreshAfterSec and maxObservationAgeSec (Gillby policies, not provider SLAs).

Units: ft, kt, s, F, mi; directions FROM. Returns data and source/freshness metadata.
name: get_california_surf
title: California swell, wind, tides and buoy observations
